name: Jellyfin
description: Servidor de mídia de código aberto para streaming de filmes, séries, músicas e fotos para qualquer dispositivo.
docker_compose:
services:
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:latest
    container_name: jellyfin
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=America/Sao_Paulo
    volumes:
      - /tank/appdata/jellyfin/config:/config
      - /tank/appdata/jellyfin/cache:/cache
      - /tank/media:/media
    ports:
      - "8096:8096/tcp"
      - "8920:8920/tcp"
      - "1900:1900/udp"
      - "7359:7359/udp"
    restart: unless-stopped

  wg-easy:
    image: wg-easy/wg-easy:latest
    container_name: wg-easy
    environment:
      - WG_HOST=seu-ip-ou-ddns.com
      - PASSWORD=adminpassword
    volumes:
      - /tank/appdata/wireguard:/etc/wireguard
    ports:
      - "51820:51820/udp"
      - "51821:51821/tcp"
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
      - SYS_MODULE
    sysctls:
      - net.ipv4.conf.all.src_valid_mark=1
      - net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
    restart: unless-stopped

name: Tailscale
description: Rede mesh VPN segura baseada em WireGuard que conecta todos os seus nós sem necessidade de abrir portas no roteador.

    container_name: tailscale
    hostname: naybinho-nas
    environment:
      - TS_AUTHKEY=tskey-auth-xxxxx
      - TS_EXTRA_ARGS=--advertise-routes=192.168.1.0/24
      - TS_STATE_DIR=/var/lib/tailscale
    volumes:
      - /tank/appdata/tailscale:/var/lib/tailscale
      - /dev/net/tun:/dev/net/tun
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
      - SYS_MODULE
    restart: unless-stopped
